title: CheckoutSession
description: A payment session, not a charge: the amount and the handoff URL where the human pays. The amount is a live quote at this moment, not a hold or a reservation, and no money moves until the human completes the page.

session_id.description: Handle for getCheckoutStatus, shaped as_ plus a UUID, good for 30 days. Null only when the session record could not be stored.

method.description: Payment rails behind the checkout, e.g. stripe, card

amount.description: Live-quoted checkout total for the anchored service, USD

service.description: The service the amount is anchored to

handoff_url.description: Opens the SMKlog checkout prefilled with this shipment

identified_product_title.description: What the estimator understood the item to be

quote_reused.description: True when the amount came from a quote_id you supplied, so no carrier call was spent

note.description: Standing caveats: live quote, human confirms consents and pays
